name: Past Endeavors
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Before you spoke to me, adventurer, I had heard of your endeavors... that you had an unyielding desire to prove yourself, that you had an exceptional ability as a champion, and I now know these things to be the truth.

Those that excel as you do are worthy of recognition. Take this marker to a friend of mine in Thunder Bluff named Melor Stonehoof. I'm sure he will remember you, and what you accomplished so long ago. Speak to him of you recent victories, and do not ever forget what you have accomplished today.
narrative.objectives: Bring Storm Shadowhoof's Marker to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
narrative.offerRewardText:
We learn from our life experiences, adventurer. From what this marker says, I am sure that you have only become stronger and wiser as a result of yours. You have grown much since we last spoke.

Take this in remembrance of the difficult tasks you have accomplished as a friend Champion, and know that you will always have my respect and admiration.
